hooks.command: repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 2; python3 "$repo_root/.codex/hooks.py" session-start || exit 2
hooks.commandWindows:
python -c "exec('import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
operation = sys.argv[1]
try:
    root = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], text=True, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=3).strip()
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(pathlib.Path(root) / '.codex/hooks.py'), operation], input=sys.stdin.read(), text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=20)
except Exception as error:
    result = subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 2, '', 'Trellis Codex launcher: ' + str(error))
if result.returncode and operation.startswith('block-'):
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': result.stderr.strip() or 'Trellis file check failed'}}))
else:
    sys.stdout.write(result.stdout)
    sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
    sys.exit(2 if result.returncode else 0)
')" session-start
